dedupe_keys.name: building footprints dataset for the republic of cyprus

description: This dataset is a single curated layer of building footprints for the whole Republic of Cyprus, harmonised from the open cadastral data of the Department of Lands and Surveys. It was prepared by Iason Giraud at the University of Cyprus and published on Zenodo on 30 July 2025. It merges three INSPIRE building layers: outlines from photogrammetry of aerial imagery, mostly of 2014 to 2016; buildings of public interest such as schools, hospitals, churches and government facilities; and registered permanent structures from cadastral digitisation. More than 1,400 municipal GML files, downloaded from the INSPIRE services in March 2024, were combined into one GeoPackage, keeping cadastral identifiers, number of floors where available and the source layer. Access: open download of the GeoPackage (about 285 MB) and the original GML files. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the photogrammetric outlines are about a decade old and floor counts are incomplete. Simulation uses are seismic and flood exposure, emergency planning around public facilities, and solar and energy modelling. Related records: GlobalBuildingAtlas and the HOT OpenStreetMap exports.
